description: This is a source file for an Android activity named ContentInfoActivity. It displays detailed information about a content item, including background image, metadata, description, and action buttons. It handles UI setup, focus management, background image loading via Coil, and interaction logic such as fetching a media URL from an API to start playback.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: Main Activity class that manages the display of content details, background image, metadata, and user interactions for playback and other functions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, configures UI elements and loads content data.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Sets up the system date and time display in the UI.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Populates the UI with content metadata received via intent extras.

methods.name: setupBackdropImage
methods.description: Loads and sets the background image for the activity if a poster URL is provided.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes focusable action buttons, sets icons, and focus change handlers.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates focus gain/loss on action buttons for visual feedback.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Executes appropriate actions for each button when clicked, including starting playback.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles remote control key events for navigation and selection.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Performs a GET request to obtain the media URL and starts the video player activity.

inner classes.name: ButtonConfig
inner classes.description: Data class for storing button label and icon resource.

companion object.name: Companion
companion object.description: Contains static constants for intent extras and a factory method to create intents.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Factory method to create an intent with content metadata to launch ContentInfoActivity.
